entities.name: On average how many carcinogenic molecules are single bonded?

properties.sql: SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) FROM (SELECT T3.molecule_id, COUNT(T1.bond_type) AS single_bond_count FROM bond AS T1  INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T3.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-' AND T3.label = '+' GROUP BY T3.molecule_id) AS subquery

entities.name: In the molecule containing sodium atoms, how many are non-carcinogenic?

properties.sql:
-- Count the molecules that contain sodium ('na') atoms and are labeled non-carcinogenic ('-')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_molecule_count
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'na' AND m.label = '-'

entities.name: Find the triple-bonded molecules which are carcinogenic.

properties.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '+' AND T2.bond_type = '#'

entities.name: What is the percentage of carbon in double-bond molecules?

properties.sql:
-- Percentage of carbon atoms among atoms belonging to molecules that contain double bonds
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'c' THEN T1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.atom_id) AS percentage_carbon_in_double_bond_molecules
FROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
) AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id

entities.name: Which type of label is the most numerous in atoms with hydrogen?

properties.sql:
-- Label (carcinogenic status) most common among hydrogen atoms
SELECT m.label
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'h'
GROUP BY m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(a.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1

entities.name: Chlorine is in what type of bond?

properties.sql:
-- Bond types formed by chlorine atoms
SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type
FROM atom AS a
INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'

entities.name: What atoms are connected in single type bonds?

properties.sql:
-- Atoms connected by single bonds
SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'

entities.name: Indicate which atoms are connected in non-carcinogenic type molecules.

properties.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.atom_id FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id WHERE T2.label = '-'

entities.name: Which element is the least numerous in non-carcinogenic molecules?

properties.sql:
-- Element with the fewest atoms among non-carcinogenic ('-') molecules
SELECT a.element
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY COUNT(a.atom_id) ASC
LIMIT 1

entities.name: What type of label is not on molecules with atoms with tin?

properties.sql:
-- Labels of molecules that do NOT contain any tin ('sn') atoms
SELECT DISTINCT m.label
FROM molecule AS m
WHERE m.molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT a.molecule_id
    FROM atom AS a
    WHERE a.element = 'sn'
)

entities.name: Identify all connected atoms with a triple bond.

properties.sql:
-- Connected atom pairs joined by a triple bond
SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'

entities.name: Identify all the atoms that are connected to the atoms of the TR181 molecule.

properties.sql: SELECT T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T2.atom_id = T1.atom_id WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR181'

entities.name: What percentage of carcinogenic-type molecules does not contain fluorine?

properties.sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element <> 'f' THEN T2.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '+'

entities.name: What is the percentage of carcinogenic molecules in triple type bonds?

properties.sql:
-- Percentage of carcinogenic molecules among molecules containing triple ('#') bonds
SELECT
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage_carcinogenic
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label
    FROM bond b
    JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
) AS t

entities.name: Please list top three elements of the toxicology of the molecule TR000 in alphabetical order.

properties.sql:

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR000'

entities.name: What are the atom IDs of the bond TR000_2_5?

entities.name: Please list top five molecules that have double bonds in alphabetical order.

entities.name: What is the percentage of double bonds in the molecule TR008? Please provide your answer as a percentage with five decimal places.

entities.name: What are the elements of the toxicology and label of molecule TR060?

FROM atom AS a

entities.name: Please list top three molecules that have single bonds between two atoms and are not carcinogenic in alphabetical order.

properties.sql:
-- Top three non-carcinogenic molecules that contain single bonds between two atoms
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  AND m.label = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3

entities.name: Please list top two bonds that happened with the molecule TR006 in alphabetical order.

entities.name: How many connections does the atom 19 have?

entities.name: Among all the atoms from 21 to 25, list all the molecules that are carcinogenic.

properties.sql:
-- Molecules (carcinogenic, label '+') that contain atoms numbered 21 through 25
SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(a.atom_id, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 21 AND 25
  AND m.label = '+'
ORDER BY a.molecule_id

entities.name: Is the molecule with the most double bonds carcinogenic?

properties.sql:
-- Find the molecule with the most double bonds ('=') and report whether it is carcinogenic
SELECT m.label
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '='
GROUP BY b.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1

entities.name: What is the average number of bonds the atoms with the element iodine have?

properties.sql:
-- Average number of bonds per iodine atom
SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS avg_bonds_per_iodine_atom
FROM atom AS a
LEFT JOIN connected AS c
       ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a.element = 'i'

entities.name: List the bond type and the bond ID of the atom 45.

entities.name: List all the elements of atoms that can not bond with any other atoms.

entities.name: What are the elements of the atoms of TR144_8_19?

entities.name: Of all the carcinogenic molecules, which one has the most double bonds?

properties.sql:

FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id

entities.name: What is the least common element of all carcinogenic molecules?

properties.sql: SELECT T.element FROM ( SELECT T2.element, COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.label = '+' GROUP BY T2.element ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) LIMIT 1 ) t

entities.name: What percentage of bonds have the most common combination of atoms' elements?

properties.sql: SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(T1.atom_id) FROM connected AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id GROUP BY T2.bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(T2.bond_id) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS REAL) * 100 / ( SELECT COUNT(atom_id) FROM connected )

entities.name: What proportion of single bonds are carcinogenic? Please provide your answer as a percentage with five decimal places.

properties.sql:

FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'

entities.name: Among the molecules with element Calcium, are they mostly carcinogenic or non carcinogenic?

entities.name: Tally the toxicology element of the 4th atom of each molecule that was carcinogenic.

entities.name: How many elements are contained in bond_id TR001_3_4?

FROM (
